purpose: Hardening of the model-neutral Continuous analyzer bake-off harness. No real model was run and no candidate winner was selected.

criticalCorrections.candidateScenarioBinding: candidate outputs are scored only against matching scenarioId
criticalCorrections.publicationOrder: canonical candidate order is validated and never silently sorted
criticalCorrections.metricStatus: MEASURED is separated from product gate PASS/FAIL
criticalCorrections.officialRanking: requires eligible EVALUATION split and no protected split leakage

sharedFinalization.productSession: ContinuousEvaluationSession builds ExpectedStrike[] from PracticeScoreArtifact and delegates to the ledger
sharedFinalization.researchScorer: Phase 9D.1 scorer feeds benchmark ExpectedStrike[] directly into the same ledger
sharedFinalization.parityTest: session and direct ledger behavior are asserted equivalent for representative chord/retrigger/extra completion

metricCorrections.extras: extra precision and extra recall are reported with matched/missed/false counts
metricCorrections.aggregation: candidate aggregate ratios pool metric numerators and denominators
